runs.text:
The home of horror on YouTube. ALTER is a curated channel of independent short films - every one licensed directly from its creators, every one chosen because it pushes the genre forward. Filmmakers: submit your work on FilmFreeway. Viewers: this is where you see what horror becomes next. Slip into the dark, disturbing corners of cutting-edge horror, because you deserve to be disturbed. Stay ALTERed. 

Beyond our longstanding presence on YouTube, ALTER also operates a free streaming tv channel available on Samsung TV+, Tubi, Plex, CW, DIRECTV, LG Channels, and Sling FreeStream.
